en-US.author: Nightmare TV
en-US.description: IPTV player for your own M3U and Xtream Codes playlists, with program guide and recording.
en-US.longDescription:
Nightmare TV is an IPTV player for playlists you already have. Add an M3U or M3U8 link or file, or sign in with your provider's Xtream Codes details. No channels, playlists or subscriptions are included.
Playback runs on the libmpv engine with HDR tone mapping. The program guide reads XMLTV (EPG) data, and catch-up works where your provider supports it. On Windows you can record live or schedule recordings, and multiview lets you watch several channels side by side.
Every install gets a 7-day free trial that starts at the first successful playback, no card and no account required. A paid license is needed to keep using the app after the trial.
en-US.name: Nightmare TV
en-US.releaseNotes:
Nightmare TV 2.2.6
Home channels from your own films and series, a way to watch what you missed during a stream drop, and a redesigned Home.
- Home channels: turn the films and series in your Xtream list into channels that run like TV.
- Missed seconds (Windows): if a live stream drops on a channel with an archive, the app can offer the part you missed. You watch it at 1.3x and return to live.
- Live: new Unfinished shelf and Resume from a time on archive channels.
- Home Tower preview: open the channel a Windows computer at home is playing on your Android TV, with parental locks respected and more than one source.
- Home: redesigned layout with Last channel, Sports, Series and Movies cards, and clearer remote focus.
- Player: a notice appears when a channel sends no picture.
- Windows: open .m3u and .m3u8 files with Nightmare TV.
- Windows: the last picture stays on screen while the next channel opens.
- Glass Ledger replaces Session Receipt: one live list of app requests.
- Best copy now prefers a reliable 50 fps copy of the same channel. The Smoothness Report shows a one line summary.
- Catch-up: archive times now follow your provider's clock.
- Back and Esc behave more reliably in the player and on Servers.
